info.name: AirAPI - SS-6258 routing classification
info.description: Ticket-scoped AirAPI Search regression. routingInversion is an internal boolean; passenger-visible fare routing remains natural.

item.name: Routing inversion is an internal boolean

exec: pm.test('[' + caseId + '] URL is resolved', function () { pm.expect(usedUrl).to.not.include('{{'); });
pm.test('[' + caseId + '] Search succeeds', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
let body; try { body = pm.response.json(); } catch (error) { pm.test('[' + caseId + '] Search response is JSON', function () { throw error; }); return; }
pm.test('[' + caseId + '] results are returned', function () { pm.expect(body.results).to.be.an('array').that.is.not.empty; });

results.forEach(function (result, resultIndex) { const calculation = result.keys && result.keys.commission_info && result.keys.commission_info.fareCalculation; pm.test('[' + caseId + '] result ' + resultIndex + ' exposes fare calculation', function () { pm.expect(calculation).to.be.an('object'); }); if (!calculation) return; const findSegment = function (tripId, segmentId) { const trip = (result.trips || []).find(function (item) { return item.tripId === tripId; }); return trip && (trip.segments || []).find(function (item) { return item.segmentId === segmentId; }); }; Object.keys(calculation).forEach(function (paxType) { (calculation[paxType] || []).forEach(function (fare, fareIndex) { const refs = fare.segments || []; if (!refs.length) return; const first = findSegment(refs[0].tripId, refs[0].segmentId); const last = findSegment(refs[refs.length - 1].tripId, refs[refs.length - 1].segmentId); const label = '[' + caseId + '] result ' + resultIndex + ' ' + paxType + '[' + fareIndex + ']'; pm.test(label + ' has boolean routingInversion', function () { pm.expect(fare.routingInversion).to.be.a('boolean'); }); pm.test(label + ' keeps passenger-visible route in physical order', function () { pm.expect(first).to.not.be.undefined; pm.expect(last).to.not.be.undefined; pm.expect(fare.departure).to.equal(first.departureAirportCode); pm.expect(fare.arrival).to.equal(last.arrivalAirportCode); }); flags.push(fare.routingInversion); }); }); });
pm.test('[' + caseId + '] non-inverted fares use false', function () { pm.expect(flags).to.include(false); });
pm.test('[' + caseId + '] returning itinerary contains an inverted fare flag', function () { pm.expect(flags).to.include(true); });
